ABOUT INGENERON

InGeneron is a clinical stage cell therapy company, developing treatments that unlock the healing potential of each patient’s own regenerative cells. Fueled by our USD 43 million Series D financing, we are conducting clinical studies – which follow the regulatory pathways outlined by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) – to obtain market approval for our regenerative cell therapy in the US.

WHAT IS OUR GOAL?

InGeneron’s objective is to change the face of medicine. We are convinced that evidence-based regenerative cell therapy will redefine the health care experience. We believe – and are working to demonstrate – that the regenerative properties of those cells can repair tissue, restoring function and minimizing pain, thereby opening a new category of treatment. Our purpose is to set new therapeutic standards in this emerging field. Currently, we focus on helping patients with a reduced quality of life as a result of musculoskeletal indications and are pursuing research to extend the application of our platform technology to additional treatment areas.
